name: G2 Kunsthalle
notes: G2 Kunsthalle in Leipzig, on the third floor of the former data processing centre of the city (VEB Datenverarbeitungszentrum, built 1986-89 in the Kolonnadenviertel) at Dittrichring 13: a long six-storey block of pale panels with punched windows in rows between piers, floor-edge bands, shop fronts at street level, a set-back top floor with a glass-enclosed lounge, facing the ring road across the reopened Pleissemuehlgraben. Refined 6 Oct 2026 from the ground file's OpenStreetMap outlines and published descriptions (the Kunsthalle's and the city's pages), not photographs: the first model stood east of the millrace, on the ring road's side (on 9%); it now stands on its outline west of the water: a long arm 13 m deep running south-south-east along the millrace for about 48 m, widening at its south end into a block about 35 by 38 m, the millrace and Dittrichring beside it as the ground has them, the four- and five-storey neighbours to the west and north-west. Still guessed: the panels' colour and the window rhythm, the height (six storeys, 19.8 m, and the top floor), where the lounge is, how the arm meets the south block, which the outline gives only in 7 m cells.
